crypto_keylength_justification:
At merged source revision 120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa, the project's Home Assistant and both Loki HTTPS clients retain ordinary CA and hostname verification and inspect every certificate in the selected verified chain, including its trust anchor, before sending HTTP data. The exact minima are RSA modulus >=2048 bits, EC >=224 bits, and DSA p>=2048/q>=224; Ed25519 and Ed448 are supported. Unknown algorithms, unavailable verified chains and missing parser dependencies fail closed. TLS uses the supported CPython/OpenSSL protocol and symmetric-cipher security floor. Calibrated TLS1.2 tests additionally reject exact 2047-bit finite-field DH parameters and accept 2048-bit parameters across all three clients; TLS1.3 uses the library's standard groups. This was verified in native CPython 3.12/OpenSSL 3.5.7 tests and in 90 offline tests under ARMv7 emulation using the actual supported CPython 3.12.13/OpenSSL 3.0.20/glibc 2.36 image and installed TLS dependency bundle. The ARMv7 GitHub Actions job downloaded SHA-256-verified upstream wheels and CFFI source/build inputs, built CFFI with networking disabled, then installed and tested the three-wheel TLS dependency closure offline. Native imports and six certificate-key boundary cases were verified: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/actions/runs/37821951215/job/113465980963 .

The deployment and restart SSH helpers require OpenSSH 9.1+ (or equivalent RequiredRSASize support), preserve an operator's stricter RSA minimum and enforce at least 2048 bits. They disable multiplexed connection reuse so the current policy is applied at authentication. Normal host-key verification, user, port and proxy configuration remain in force. Operator-supplied ProxyJump or ProxyCommand connections are independent transports and must apply their own RSA minimum of at least 2048 bits, as documented. Content-integrity hashes use SHA256; Git SHA1 object identifiers are compatibility identifiers, explicitly not used as security digests.

Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/inverter_control/tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/inverter_control/requests_tls.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/inverter_control/ssh_policy.sh ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/tests/test_tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/tests/test_tls_key_exchange.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/tests/test_ssh_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa/docs/tls-dependencies.md

This assessment concerns the published source at 120e3b5ae977975aeb9d080b4216d62f793934fa and its documented supported profile. It does not assert that a tagged release package containing this revision has been published or that the correction has been installed on any device. It does not claim that intentional plaintext local transports are encrypted, that third-party operators have configured their services correctly, or that physical installations have been tested. Manual SSH tunnels and transfers, externally installed SetupHelper, operating-system feeds and development/bootstrap tools are separately operated tools; the runtime adapters do not certify those tools or arbitrary custom configuration.
crypto_working_justification: Project security hashes use SHA-256, HTTPS retains certificate verification and the supported platform TLS defaults, and no project override enables broken algorithms. Plaintext local protocols are explicitly documented and require an authenticated encrypted tunnel when crossing an untrusted boundary: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md

crypto_pfs_justification: The audited supported Python 3.12 urllib3 TLS context offers TLS 1.3 or ephemeral ECDHE/DHE suites. The application does not weaken those defaults. External gateways and device runtimes must be validated separately; this claim does not cover plaintext MQTT/HTTP: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/openssf-evidence.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
crypto_password_storage_justification: The controller does not maintain accounts or store password verifiers for authenticating external users. Operator-supplied upstream bearer/client credentials are protected as secrets, not treated as password hashes: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
crypto_random_justification: The application does not implement its own key or nonce generator. Cryptographic randomness is delegated to the platform OpenSSL implementation used for TLS; the retired TLS helper does not create keys or alter trust settings: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/setup_ssl.sh

governance_justification: GOVERNANCE documents a maintainer-led model, public proposals and technical reconsideration, with the project owner responsible for final decisions and dispute resolution. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
code_of_conduct_justification: The root CODE_OF_CONDUCT describes expected behavior, prohibited harassment, reporting and enforcement within project participation. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
roles_responsibilities_justification: GOVERNANCE assigns owner, release and security responsibilities to 4alvit, describes contributor/reviewer/operator duties, and explicitly distinguishes automation from human maintainers. access_continuity_justification: Public source and runbooks do not establish administrative succession. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
bus_factor_justification: Only one human maintainer is currently documented. Bots and repository access alone do not establish a second person able to maintain the project. The current small-project model retains this limitation while publishing architecture, tests and release runbooks for future onboarding. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/GOVERNANCE.md
documentation_roadmap_justification: ROADMAP covers October 2026 through October 2027, including intended maintenance, security, compatibility and localization work, explicit exclusions, and quarterly review without promising every item will ship. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
documentation_architecture_justification: ARCHITECTURE and the linked system design describe the controller, telemetry readers, transport adapters, watchdog, state flow and component boundaries. documentation_security_justification: The security design and assurance case state expected authentication, validation, TLS, credential, replay and update properties together with the trusted-host, gateway, root-process and physical-equipment limits. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md
documentation_quick_start_justification: The quick start builds the locked developer environment and exercises the control calculation without a device; it links supported device installation separately. documentation_current_justification: The documentation was reconciled with current interfaces, separate credential files, actual build/install/signature behavior and the production-only coverage denominator. Historical releases and their older measurements are explicitly dated. Known source/documentation inconsistencies discovered in this review were corrected. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/openssf-evidence.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quality-process.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/credentials.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md
documentation_achievements_justification: The README displays and links the live OpenSSF badge and assessment. CONTRIBUTING requires recording public achievements within 48 hours; this evidence index records initial Passing and its corrected restoration without claiming Silver. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/README.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/openssf-evidence.md
accessibility_best_practices_justificati: The daemon has text/keyboard interfaces rather than a GUI. Documentation has headings and descriptive links; terminal state remains readable without color, including explicit valve values, and nonempty NO_COLOR suppresses ANSI style sequences. Formal WCAG or screen-reader conformance is not claimed for the project or external dashboards. internationalization_justification: Human-facing diagnostics are English and lack a complete translation catalog. For the present small operator audience, complete and searchable diagnostics and stable protocol identifiers take priority over a partial translation layer. The roadmap includes evaluating localization; English-only output is not treated as N/A. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/accessibility.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
sites_password_security_justification: The project website, repository, issue tracker and download hosting use GitHub authentication rather than a project-operated password database. The official Silver criteria explicitly identify GitHub hosting as meeting this site-password criterion; application bearer credentials are a separate concern. maintenance_or_update_justification: SECURITY identifies main and the active 1.23.x release line and states that older lines receive no separate backports. Release notes, update/install guidance and TLS dependency instructions provide an upgrade path while retaining operator settings and requiring site validation. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/SECURITY.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/tls-dependencies.md
vulnerability_report_credit_justificatio: SECURITY now commits to crediting every reporter except those requesting anonymity. The prior maintainer statement covers no outside vulnerability reports over six months, which does not establish the full 12-month resolved-report history required here. Neither Met nor N/A is claimed without that history. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_response_process_justifica: SECURITY documents private intake, acknowledgement targets, triage of severity and affected versions, coordination of fixes and mitigations, regression checks, disclosure, reporter credit and credential revocation. coding_standards_justification: CONTRIBUTING names PEP 8 as the Python baseline with the repository 100-character line length and Ruff configuration; shell changes must retain declared shell syntax and quoted path/argument handling. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quality-process.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/pyproject.toml
coding_standards_enforced_justification: The normal CI command runs Ruff checking and formatting under the locked environment and fails on violations. Reviewed security exceptions are documented at their source locations. The integrated run at 8858711 passed both Ruff stages; vendored release files retain documented upstream formatting annotations. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/ci.sh ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/pyproject.toml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-scanning.md
build_standard_variables_justification: The ARMv7 CFFI build accepts and forwards CC, CXX, CPPFLAGS, CFLAGS, CXXFLAGS and LDFLAGS. Caller flags are retained in both production and sanitizer builds, with required sanitizer flags appended. Local native builds recorded actual compiler inputs; this is not N/A merely because control logic is Python. build_preserve_debug_justification: The builder does not strip extensions, and the clean ARMv7 rebuild with -g confirmed .debug_info in the wheel. Staging preserves payload bytes instead of stripping debug information. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/build_tls_wheel.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/install.py
build_non_recursive_justification: Source packaging is one archive operation and CFFI is a single independent native dependency build. There is no recursive cross-directory dependency graph whose separate builds omit dependencies. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/package_release.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/build_tls_wheel.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md
build_repeatable_justification: Two clean CFFI builds in the same pinned environment produced identical wheel bytes; source and ARMv7 archives and SHA256SUMS also matched across repeated packaging. The build checks this equality and records inputs, flags and epoch. This is same-environment repeatability, not a claim that signatures or independently chosen environments produce identical bytes. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/build_tls_wheel.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/package_release.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/package_tls_bundle.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_release_archive.py
installation_common_justification: make install/uninstall use the supported setup entry points for live Venus installation and support nonprivileged staged installation/removal. The installed-file manifest enables removal of owned files while preserving added operator configuration. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/Makefile ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/install.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_install_staging.py
installation_standard_variables_justific: make, setup and update.sh honor DESTDIR before any live device helper or service action. Staging writes below DESTDIR/data/inverter-control and rejects linked escapes. Tests cover literal spaces/metacharacters and preservation of unrelated files; the runtime prefix remains fixed by Venus integration. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/Makefile ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/setup ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/update.sh ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/install.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_install_staging.py
installation_development_quick_justifica: The documented Python 3.12/uv workflow installs the locked runtime and test environment with uv sync --locked --all-extras; make check and the documented mock integration command provide local validation without hardware. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quick-start.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/uv.lock ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/Makefile
external_dependencies_justification: Python dependencies are machine-readable in pyproject.toml, uv.lock and requirements.txt. The native bundle uses hash-pinned requirements and pinned container/build inputs; release policy and package manifests identify generated payloads. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/pyproject.toml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/uv.lock ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/requirements.txt ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/build-support/tls-armv7/Dockerfile ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/tls-dependencies.md
dependency_monitoring_justification: Dependabot monitors Python dependencies weekly, Renovate handles workflow/tooling updates, and Trivy/dependency review run in the security workflows. The policy requires triage and correction or a documented non-exploitability determination; vendored release tooling is refreshed and its consumer contracts rechecked. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/.github/dependabot.yml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/renovate.json ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-security.yml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-scanning.md
updateable_reused_components_justificati: Python dependencies use standard package managers and explicit manifests; the native bundle records pinned upstream inputs and can be rebuilt with updated versions. The vendored release toolkit has a documented regeneration wrapper and consumer tests, making copied components identifiable and updateable. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/pyproject.toml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/uv.lock ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/tls-dependencies.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/regenerate_release.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/release-signatures.md
interfaces_current_justification: The known deprecated finite-field DH loader remains in the exact 2047/2048-bit security regression fixture. Keeping that test protects the supported DHE boundary while a replacement fixture API is evaluated; there is no runtime dependency on this loader. This is an explicit temporary exception to the recommendation, not a blanket claim that all used APIs are current. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quality-process.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/tls-dependencies.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_key_exchange.py
automated_integration_testing_justificat: Each push to main starts release-pipeline with full validation; pull requests use the quality gate. The automated suite produces pass/fail and coverage reports. The completed integrated local CI at 8858711 passed 2182 tests with two skips; required hosted checks remain part of merge/release validation. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-pipeline.yml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality-gate.yml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/ci.sh
regression_tests_added50_justification: The six-month source-history audit screens 475 baseline commits and records 148 tested defects out of 282 conservative candidates. Reviewed PR305 and Silver extensions yield 169/304 (55.59%). Uncertain candidates and the coverage-measurement correction remain in the denominator without credit. Two independent samples, retrospective old/current comparisons and strengthened mutation-sensitive tests support the mappings. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/regression-audit.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/evidence/regression-extension-2026-10-09.json
test_statement_coverage80_justification: At integrated source 8858711, the run passed 2182 tests and reported 7972/9273 measured production statements (85.9700%). Review then found 19 tracked Python files absent from that report because unimported scripts were not discovered. The owner is enabling namespace discovery and including release/workflow suites in the same coverage run. Neither that partial report nor earlier percentages including tests establishes complete production coverage. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/pyproject.toml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/ci.sh ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quality-process.md
test_policy_mandated_justification: CONTRIBUTING and the quality policy require automated tests for major new functionality and relevant failure cases before acceptance. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/quality-process.md
implement_secure_design_justification: The assurance case maps fail-safe defaults, complete mediation at input boundaries, open design, separation of duties, least privilege for credential files and limited shared state to concrete implementations and tests. It candidly treats root execution and broker/gateway authentication as trusted deployment constraints. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md
crypto_algorithm_agility_justification: TLS and OpenSSH negotiate multiple supported modern suites and can be updated through maintained runtime/dependency packages. Cryptographic primitives are delegated to those libraries rather than embedded in the control algorithm. This does not promise arbitrary user-selected algorithms for fixed content manifests. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/tls-dependencies.md
crypto_credential_agility_justification: HA_TOKEN_FILE stores the Home Assistant bearer token separately with bounded regular-file and permission checks; atomic replacement plus controlled restart changes it without rebuilding. Authenticated Loki uses a separately stored netrc credential reloaded for each batch. SSH private keys remain in separate operator-managed files; no unsupported daemon mutual-TLS key configuration is claimed. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/credentials.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/credentials.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_credentials.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_log_forwarder.py
crypto_used_network_justification: For compatibility with the trusted Venus host/broker environment, MQTT, webhook, console and metrics retain plaintext local defaults and legacy HA HTTP remains configurable. Remote use requires verified HTTPS or an authenticated encrypted tunnel/gateway. This explicit exception does not claim every default connection is encrypted. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-design.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/prometheus-alerts.md
crypto_tls12_justification: All supported project HTTPS paths require TLS 1.2 or newer and preserve TLS 1.3 support through the supported CPython/OpenSSL environment. Positive/negative transport tests exercise all three HTTPS clients. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/requests_tls.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_key_exchange.py
crypto_certificate_verification_justific: Home Assistant and both Loki HTTPS transports retain CA/hostname verification by default, then inspect the complete selected verified chain on the actual connection. Missing inspection capability or weak/unsupported keys fail closed. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/inverter_control/requests_tls.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_policy.py
crypto_verification_private_justificatio: Tests require certificate verification and exact selected-chain key checks on the connection before any private HTTP headers or body are sent, including Requests and the supported urllib fallback. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_policy.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_tls_key_exchange.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md
signed_releases_justification: The implementation signs SHA256SUMS covering source and ARMv7 payloads using an ephemeral Sigstore/OIDC job, and documents recipient verification against fixed issuer, workflow, source repository/ref and reviewed SHA. No actual signed public release and successful recipient verification have yet been established. Existing unsigned releases and a workflow definition are not sufficient evidence. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/release-signatures.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/.github/workflows/release-build.yml ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/release_signatures.py
version_tags_signed_justification: Git tags remain lightweight unsigned pointers. Planned artifact Sigstore signatures do not make tags cryptographically signed; this suggestion is not claimed as fulfilled. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/release-signatures.md
input_validation_justification: The reviewed input boundaries apply allowlisted commands/topics and schema, type, size and numeric-domain checks before state mutation. This includes bounded MQTT/HTTP, precharge identity/expiry, finite forecast energy, integer setpoints, finite intervals, safe HA entity paths and confined install/release paths. Positive and negative regression cases passed; the assurance case states the remaining trusted-configuration and broker-level resource assumptions. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_command_input.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_forecast_input.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_mqtt_bridge.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/tests/test_install_staging.py
hardening_justification: The CFFI production build enables strong stack protection and linker RELRO/NOW and retains caller flags. Python manages memory in the control implementation, while bounded queues/parsers and fail-closed transport/credential handling limit fault effects. The separate sanitizer build tests memory access; no hardening of arbitrary external prebuilt wheels or a root-process sandbox is claimed. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/build-support/tls-armv7/Dockerfile ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/scripts/build_tls_wheel.py ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md ; https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/build-and-install.md
assurance_case_justification: The published security assurance case states assets, attacker capabilities, trust boundaries, security requirements and arguments linked to source/tests; it maps secure-design principles and common implementation weaknesses and records deployment assumptions and residual limits. Evidence: https://github.com/victron-venus/inverter-control/blob/main/docs/security-assurance.md
